tables.template_asset: CREATE TABLE `template_asset` ( `id` char(36) NOT NULL, `filename` varchar(80) NOT NULL, `media_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `byte_size` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL, `width` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL, `height` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL, `content_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL, `created_by` char(36) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uniq_template_asset_filename` (`filename`), KEY `fk_template_asset_actor` (`created_by`), CONSTRAINT `fk_template_asset_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `app_user` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT `chk_template_asset_media` CHECK (`media_type` in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
tables.template_version: CREATE TABLE `template_version` ( `id` char(36) NOT NULL, `template_id` char(36) NOT NULL, `version_number` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL, `subject` varchar(200) NOT NULL, `preheader` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL, `html_body` mediumtext NOT NULL, `text_body` mediumtext NOT NULL, `merge_fields_json` longtext NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`merge_fields_json`)), `link_manifest_json` longtext NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`link_manifest_json`)), `content_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL, `created_by` char(36) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `published_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uniq_template_version` (`template_id`,`version_number`), KEY `idx_template_version_created` (`template_id`,`created_at`), KEY `fk_template_version_actor` (`created_by`), CONSTRAINT `fk_template_version_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `app_user` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT `fk_template_version_template` FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `email_template` (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
tables.user_session: CREATE TABLE `user_session` ( `id_hash` char(64) NOT NULL, `user_id` char(36) DEFAULT NULL, `payload` mediumblob NOT NULL, `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `last_seen_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `idle_expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `absolute_expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `revoked_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL, `source_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL, `user_agent_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id_hash`), KEY `idx_user_session_user_active` (`user_id`,`revoked_at`,`last_seen_at`), KEY `idx_user_session_expiry` (`idle_expires_at`,`absolute_expires_at`), KEY `idx_session_reclaim` (`revoked_at`,`absolute_expires_at`), CONSTRAINT `fk_user_session_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `app_user` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
tables.worker_heartbeat: CREATE TABLE `worker_heartbeat` ( `worker_id` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `worker_kind` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `schema_version` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL, `started_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `heartbeat_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL, `stopped_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`worker_id`), KEY `idx_worker_heartbeat` (`worker_kind`,`heartbeat_at`), CONSTRAINT `chk_worker_kind` CHECK (`worker_kind` in ('worker','scheduler')) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

triggers.audience_no_delete_after_snapshot: CREATE TRIGGER audience_no_delete_after_snapshot BEFORE DELETE ON campaign_audience_recipient FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_audience_snapshot WHERE campaign_id = OLD.campaign_id) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Approved campaign recipients are immutable'; END IF; END
triggers.audience_no_insert_after_snapshot: CREATE TRIGGER audience_no_insert_after_snapshot BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_audience_recipient FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_audience_snapshot WHERE campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Approved campaign recipients are immutable'; END IF; END

triggers.audit_event_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER audit_event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_event FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Audit events are append-only'
triggers.audit_event_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER audit_event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_event FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Audit events are append-only'
triggers.campaign_audience_model_immutable: CREATE TRIGGER campaign_audience_model_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON campaign FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF BINARY NEW.audience_model <> BINARY OLD.audience_model THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Campaign audience provenance is immutable'; END IF; END
triggers.campaign_audience_recipient_identity_ins: CREATE TRIGGER campaign_audience_recipient_identity_insert BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_audience_recipient FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SET NEW.recipient_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.recipient_id,''), NEW.contact_id); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign c WHERE c.id = NEW.campaign_id AND ((c.audience_model = 'campaign_owned' AND NEW.contact_id IS NULL) OR (c.audience_model = 'list' AND NEW.contact_id IS NOT NULL))) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Campaign audience model mismatch'; END IF; END
triggers.campaign_audience_recipient_identity_upd: CREATE TRIGGER campaign_audience_recipient_identity_update BEFORE UPDATE ON campaign_audience_recipient FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SET NEW.recipient_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.recipient_id,''), NEW.contact_id); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign c WHERE c.id = NEW.campaign_id AND ((c.audience_model = 'campaign_owned' AND NEW.contact_id IS NULL) OR (c.audience_model = 'list' AND NEW.contact_id IS NOT NULL))) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Campaign audience model mismatch'; END IF; END
triggers.campaign_recipient_identity_insert: CREATE TRIGGER campaign_recipient_identity_insert BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_recipient FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SET NEW.recipient_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.recipient_id,''), NEW.contact_id); IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_audience_recipient a WHERE a.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id AND a.recipient_id = NEW.recipient_id AND a.contact_id <=> NEW.contact_id) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Recipient provenance mismatch'; END IF; END

triggers.suppression_match_after_delete: CREATE TRIGGER suppression_match_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON suppression FOR EACH ROW INSERT IGNORE INTO suppression_match (email_match_key,suppression_id) SELECT email_match_key,MIN(id) FROM suppression WHERE email_match_key = OLD.email_match_key GROUP BY email_match_key
triggers.suppression_match_after_insert: CREATE TRIGGER suppression_match_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON suppression FOR EACH ROW INSERT IGNORE INTO suppression_match (email_match_key,suppression_id) VALUES (NEW.email_match_key,NEW.id)
